text:
sara_sales: Quick one 1 FinGuard procurement needs ISO/ISMS artifacts to approve the 2-week POC. They want scope, SoA/applicability statement, and key policies. Can security assemble a redacted bundle today?

ali_security: @sara_sales we can. Clarify: POC on hosted Redwood API, correct? That affects scope language (hosted vs on-prem).

sara_sales: Hosted. Theyll process sample invoice documents (PII present). No model uploads.

ali_security: OK. For a sales-friendly bundle we'll include: short ISMS scope statement, a compact Statement of Applicability mapping ISO controls to status (Implemented / Partially / N/A), redacted policy PDFs (Access Control, Crypto, Incident Response, Backup), cert copy or link (redacted), and a one-page architecture/dataflow for the POC.

matt_engineering: I'll make the one-pager showing ephemeral API keys, no weights stored, TLS in transit, KMS for platform-managed keys, and logship to our SIEM. ETA 3h.

dana_poc: I can create a dedicated POC org and scoped keys. FinGuard asked whether our ISMS explicitly excludes customer-managed on-prem deployments; they want that spelled out in the scope.

ali_security: We'll add exact wording: "ISMS coverage: Redwood Inference hosted and Dedicated control planes and inference services. Exclusions: customer-managed on-prem deployments and customer-controlled model artifacts/weights."

ali_security: Note: raw audit workpapers are not shareable without legal approval. We can provide redacted extracts and the SoA. If they request deeper evidence, we'll escalate.

sara_sales: Procurement will accept redacted cert + SoA + policies. They requested a short applicability table showing which controls apply to hosted POC. Can we produce that?

ali_security: Yes. We'll produce a condensed applicability table (one page) that marks controls relevant for hosted API usage (e.g., A.8, A.9, A.10 entries) with brief notes.

security_bot: Certificate link: <https://vendors.redwood.com/certs/iso27001-2025.pdf> (access: sales-team) :white_check_mark:

ali_security: Draft bundle uploaded to /shared/sales/FinGuard_POC_ISO_bundle.zip. Please review the scope sentence and the SoA mapping.

sara_sales: Reviewing now. If approved I'll upload to their vendor portal and confirm. Procurement wants docs within 24h.

matt_engineering: Confirmed diagram added. Also included log retention window and key storage details.

dana_poc: Uploaded keys for the POC org and limited dataset ready. Will wait til docs are in portal to start.

sara_sales: FinGuard replied: "Looks sufficient for procurement. Proceed with onboarding." I'll attach the bundle to the portal now.

ali_security: If they ask for any control-specific evidence (like configuration screenshots), coordinate with Eng and Compliance for a scoped deliverable.

sara_sales: Thanks team, closing once portal upload done.
